info.comment: If you love it, don't forget to click the LoveIt button! =PThis is a remake of the classic video game Duck Hunt for the NES. Move the crosshair using the mouse and click it. You have to shoot the ducks, but if you miss 3 times the duck will run away. As the game goes on, the ducks get faster and more unpredictable.The main problem with making this program was the layer issues. I've gotten the layers to be the right way most of the time, but occasionally the duck indicator sprites get buried behind the SHOT sprite and (very rarely) the dog appears in front of the grass instead of behind.This program is my most complicated one yet, with a total of 136 scripts. This is because I abuse the broadcast system.
info.author: S65
